verses.text: When I, Ezekiel, was thirty years old, I was living alongside the Kebar River, among the Israelite people whom the Babylonians had forcibly removed from the land of Judah. It was on the fifth day of the fourth month that the sky looked as though it was opening, and I beheld God’s very presence.
That day was almost five years after the Babylonian King Nebuchadnezzar forcibly removed King Jehoiachin from Jerusalem.

God spoke his messages directly to me, Ezekiel the priest, Buzi’s son, at the time when I lived in the land of the Chaldeans, along the Kebar River. Yahweh empowered me to receive what God wanted me to see and hear.

Then I looked, and what I saw was a windstorm coming out of the north. It took the shape of a large cloud with a massive fire burning within itself. A brilliant light radiated all around the storm, and its center glowed like hot metal in a fire.
In the very center of the windstorm appeared what seemed to be four creatures. Here is what they looked like—they resembled humans,
but every one of them had four different faces and four wings.
Their two legs were straight, like human legs, but their two feet resembled the hooves of calves, and they glowed like the glimmer of polished bronze.
Each creature had human hands, which rested underneath the wing that was on each of their four sides. As for their four faces and four wings—

each creature’s wing touched the wing of another, so that, together, the four creatures formed a square. Whenever they moved, they did not turn, but instead moved forward in the direction of one of their four faces.

Now, their faces looked like this: In front, each creature had a face that resembled a human face. The face on the right side resembled a lion’s face. The face on the left side resembled an ox’s face, and the face in the back resembled an eagle’s face.

That was what their faces looked like. As for their wings, each creature had his four wings raised and spread out above them. Two of each creature’s wings touched two of the wings of the other creatures that were on either side of it. The other two wings they folded so as to cover their bodies.
Without turning as they went, these creatures always moved in the direction of one of their faces. They advanced in whichever direction their spirit guided them.

The form of the four creatures resembled glowing charcoal in the middle of a blazing fire or like flaming torches. Their fire flashed back and forth among the four creatures. It gave off a brilliant, fiery light, and streaks of lightning darted out of the fire.
Yes, the creatures were moving back and forth so rapidly that they resembled lightning strikes!
Then I looked at the creatures, and what I saw was a single wheel on the ground beside each of the four-faced creatures.
Each wheel was identical, and they all glistened like the gleam of a fine topaz. In terms of their construction, each wheel was made of a single wheel intersecting another wheel.
Without rotating as they went, the wheels likewise always moved in one of the four directions corresponding to one of the faces of the four-faced creatures.
As for the outer rims of the wheels—they were towering and terrifying, and each one of the four creatures’ wheels was completely covered with eyes!
Whenever the creatures advanced, their wheels advanced alongside them. Likewise, whenever the creatures ascended above the ground, so too did their wheels.

The four creatures’ wheels advanced in whichever direction their spirit guided them. Likewise, the wheels rose alongside their creature, because the wheels contained the creature’s spirit that gave them life.

Whenever the four creatures advanced, their wheels also advanced. Whenever the creatures stopped moving, their wheels also stopped. And whenever the creatures rose above the ground, their wheels also rose alongside. This was because the wheels contained the creatures’ spirit that gave them life.
Above the heads of the creatures, there was something that resembled a vaulted dome. It was awesome and glistened like crystals of ice, arching high over their heads.

Under the vaulted dome, each creature’s four wings were stretched out—two were touching the wings of the other creatures that were on either side of it, and two were folded to cover the creature’s body.

Then I heard the noise that their wings made when the four creatures advanced. The noise of their wings sounded like the crashing of ocean waves, or like the voice of the all-powerful God. It sounded like the din of a massive crowd of people, or like the uproar of an army marching to war. Whenever the creatures stopped, they lowered their outstretched wings.
Then the creatures stopped and lowered their outstretched wings. A voice coming from above the vaulted dome that was over their heads began to speak.

Then, above the vaulted dome that arched high over the heads of the four creatures, there was something that resembled a king’s royal chair. It looked like someone had hewn it from sapphire stones. And something sat high above on that sapphire throne—a creature that looked human.

I noticed that, above what seemed like his waist, the bodily form of this human-like creature resembled the glowing of hot metal, completely enclosed by fire. Then, I noticed that the bodily form below what seemed like his waist resembled a blazing fire. Radiating all around, brilliant light

shone like a rainbow in the clouds on a rainy day. This is what the brilliant radiance that glowed all around looked like. This light displayed how powerful and glorious Yahweh is while he appeared to me. When I saw all of this, I bowed with my face to the ground. Then, I heard the human-like creature who was sitting on that sapphire throne begin to speak.
The one sitting on the throne said to me, “Human, stand up! Then I will speak to you.”
As he said this, God’s Spirit came upon me and enabled me to stand up. Then I heard the one sitting on the throne speak to me.

He said, “Human, I am about to send you to the Israelite people. Every one of the family clans of Israel has rejected my authority and refused to obey me as my people, like they promised to do. They, like their ancestors, have never stopped openly defying me—even to this very day!
My children, the people of Israel, are obstinate and stubborn. I am sending you to talk to them on my behalf. You must declare to them what I, the Lord Yahweh, am speaking to them directly.

As for them, when you declare my messages, the Israelite people may indeed heed what you tell them, or they may yet refuse to listen. After all, these people reject my authority and openly defy me! Nevertheless, they will eventually admit that a prophet has been among them, and that Yahweh himself is speaking to them!

But as for you, human, you must not be afraid of them, nor fear what they say. These people will be as hurtful to you as thorns and thistles are to your skin! Living among them will be like living among scorpions! Still, you must not allow what they say about you to make you afraid, or let their presence terrify you. After all, these people reject my authority and openly defy me!
Nonetheless, declare my message to them. The Israelite people may indeed heed what you tell them, or they may still refuse to listen. After all, they openly defy me!
As for you, human, you must heed whatever I say to you. You must not openly defy me like these people frequently do! Now, open your mouth! Eat what I am about to give you.”
Then, as I watched, I saw him stretch out his hand to me, and I saw that he was holding a scroll that contained writing.
He unfurled the scroll so that I could see it. On both sides of it, someone had written the words of poems that expressed despair, grief, and warning.
The one sitting on the throne said to me, “Human, eat it. Yes, eat this scroll! Then, go! Declare my message to the Israelite people.”
I opened my mouth wide, and he fed the scroll to me.
Then he said to me, “Human, chew and swallow the scroll that I have given to you. Fill your stomach with it.” I did so, and it tasted as sweet as honey in my mouth.
Then he said to me, “Human, it is time for you to go to the Israelite people, so that you might declare my message to them.
The people to whom I am sending you do not speak a language that is so complex that it is difficult to speak or understand. I am sending you to your own Israelite people.

Again, I am not sending you to many different people who speak languages that are too complex, whose language you cannot understand. If I were to send you to those people, they would heed your message!
Yet the Israelite people will never want to heed what you say. After all, they do not even want to heed what I, Yahweh, say! This is because all of them are obstinate and stubborn.
But, pay attention! I have enabled you to be as obstinate to them as they are to me, and as stubbornly opposed to them as they are to me!

I have enabled you to be more resolute and dangerous to the Israelite people than a thorn that is extremely hard! Still, you must not allow them to make you afraid or let their presence terrify you. After all, these people reject my authority and openly defy me!”
Then he said to me, “Human, think very carefully about everything I say to you, and listen to it attentively.

So now, go to your own people, your fellow Israelites, whom the Babylonians have forcibly removed from the land of Judah, so that you can talk to them. You must declare to them what I, the Lord Yahweh, am speaking to them directly. You must do this whether the Israelite people heed what you tell them or whether they refuse to listen.”
Then God’s Spirit lifted me up. Behind me, I heard something that sounded like a massive earthquake. The sound sounded like someone shouting the words, “Praise our glorious Yahweh in the temple!”

I also heard the noise of the wings of the four creatures as they began to flap and brush against the other creatures’ wings, along with the noise of the wheels advancing alongside them. All of this sounded as if it were a massive earthquake.
Then God’s Spirit carried me up and took me away from the river. Yet, as I went, I was resentful and angry, and Yahweh was powerfully authorizing me to declare his message.

So, I went to the people whom the Babylonians had forcibly removed from Judah and resettled in the town of Tel Aviv near the Kebar River in Babylon. There, where they were living, I sat down and did not move for seven days. I sat there among them, completely overwhelmed.
After those seven days had ended, Yahweh spoke this message to me,

“Human, I am appointing you to give warnings of danger to the Israelite people like the watchman at the gate of a city. So, when you hear the message that I speak to you directly, you must declare it to the people to warn them.

Now, I might declare that a sinful person is assuredly going to die because of his sin. And you might choose not to warn him or inform him that, if he desires to save his life, he must cease his sinful lifestyle. If you do this, the sinful person will die because of his sinful behavior. However, I will consider that you are responsible for his death, {since you did not act to prevent it}.

However, you might choose to warn that sinful person, and yet he might not cease his sinful lifestyle. If this happens, that person will die because of his sinful behavior. Yet, as for you, you will have prevented me from punishing you.

Alternatively, a just person might cease his honest behavior and begin acting unjustly. When that happens, I may cause his life to become difficult. That person will die because of his sin. However, you might choose not to warn him that he deserves to die. If you do this, the formerly just person will die nevertheless, because of his recent unjust behavior. I will not credit him for the just things that he once did. However, I will consider that you are responsible for his death, {since you did not act to prevent it}.

However, you might choose to warn that previously just person, so that he ceases his sinful behavior and returns to his just lifestyle. If this happens, that individual will continue to live because you warned him that he would die because of his sin. Furthermore, as for you, you will have prevented me from punishing you.”
Then, Yahweh was powerfully present with me there. He spoke to me, “Stand up, and travel to the valley outside of town. At that place, I will talk to you.”

So, I stood up and went out to the valley. There, I suddenly saw the powerful and glorious vision of Yahweh standing before me. It was just like the glorious vision that I had seen when I was beside the Kebar River. When I saw it, I bowed with my face to the ground.
Then, God’s Spirit came upon me and enabled me to stand up. Yahweh said to me, “Go into your house and lock yourself inside it.
As for you, human—pay attention! The people who live near you will tie you up with ropes, so that you will be unable to go out among them.

And I will make you unable to speak, as if you were mute and your tongue was stuck to the top of your mouth. So, I will make it impossible for you to pronounce my rebukes against these people. After all, every one of the Israelite people continuously refuses to listen to me or obey me!

However, whenever I tell you my messages, I will empower you to declare them to the Israelite people. You must declare to the people what I, the Lord Yahweh, am speaking to them directly. The one who is willing to listen to me will listen, but the one who refuses to accept my message will continue to refuse me. After all, they are all people who continuously reject me and disobey me!”
{Yahweh continued to speak to me,} “As for you, human, find yourself a large clay brick. Then, you should place it in front of you and draw a picture of the city of Jerusalem on it.

Then, lay siege to your drawing of Jerusalem! Build siegeworks around it and construct a siege ramp that allows soldiers to climb over the outer walls! Post enemy soldiers outside of the city! Assemble battering rams around your drawing of Jerusalem to knock down its outer gates!

Then, find yourself an iron frying pan, and set it so that it resembles a vast iron wall. It should separate you and your drawing of Jerusalem on the clay brick. Then, turn to face it with firm resolve to besiege the city until your army destroys and captures it. This will be a warning for the Israelite people [that I am about to judge them}.

Next, you should lie down on your left side and pretend to bear the entirety of the sins of the people of the northern kingdom of Israel on your right side, as if they were a heavy burden. You must continue to lie down and symbolically endure the weight of the sins of the northern kingdom of the Israelite people for a symbolic number of days. Now, I myself have determined the exact length of time during which you should do this: One day for each of the years that the northern kingdom of Israel has sinned against me. So you must perform this symbolic act for 390 days, and bear the sins of the northern kingdom of the Israelite people.

When you have finished lying on your left side for 390 days, you should lie down a second time. This time, lie on your right side, and symbolically bear the sins of the people of the southern kingdom of Judah. I have determined that you should, once again, lie down one day for each of the years that I will punish the people of Judah for their sins against me: 40 days.

So, you should firmly resolve within yourself with regard to your drawing of the siege of Jerusalem, and stretch out your bare arm against it. As you do this, you must proclaim my prophetic messages against the city.

Now, pay attention! I am going to fix you in place as you lie down. You will not be able to turn from one side to the other, as though I have tied you down with ropes. You will remain this way until you have finished lying down for the number of days that I have determined for your symbolic act.

As for you, you should acquire portions of wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and rye. You should store these together in a single container and use the mixed grains, seeds, and legumes to bake bread for yourself. You will eat this bread throughout the 390 days during which you lie on your left side.
Your meals must be weighed to be eight ounces a day. You must eat it at fixed times throughout the day.
Likewise, any water that you drink must be measured to be a pint and a half. You must also drink at fixed times throughout the day.
You should eat your meals like you would eat a loaf of barley bread. However, you must bake your food while the Israelite people are watching, using human excrement for fuel.”

Yahweh continued to talk to me. He said, “Your carefully weighed and measured meals that you cook over human excrement will symbolize to the Israelite people that they too will resort to eating food that is unacceptable to me when I force them out of their land to live among the people groups that surround them.”

But I declared, “Oh, Lord Yahweh! Please, do not force me to eat my meals in this ritually impure manner! I have never done anything that caused a priest to declare that I was not able to worship in your presence. As long as I have been alive, I have never once eaten the disgusting meat of roadkill or carrion, nor have I ever eaten any desecrated meat from a spoiled sacrifice!”
Yahweh replied, “Very well. I will allow you to bake your bread using dried cow manure instead of human excrement for fuel.”

Then he said to me, “Human, I am about to remove Jerusalem’s supply of bread, on which they rely like a walking stick. When I do this, the people who live in Jerusalem will resort to anxiously rationing their meager meals and drinking their carefully allocated portions of water in increasing panic.

This will happen because I will make food and water scarce for the people who live in Jerusalem. Every individual will feel a horrified shock of terror. Because I am punishing them, the wrongs that they have committed will cause them to experience life as if they were something that someone has left out to rot.”
“As for you, human, you must acquire a sharp sword and use it like a barber’s razor to shave your head and your beard. Then, you must acquire a scale and weigh the hair that you removed.

After your siege of the drawing of the city of Jerusalem is completed, you must take a third of the hair that you have weighed and burn it in a fire in the middle of your drawing of the city of Jerusalem that you have besieged. Then, you must take another third of the hair and slash at it with your sword so that it falls all around the city. Then throw the final third of the hair so that it disperses in the wind. I myself will cut up the hair that flies away in the wind, as if I unleashed a sword against it.
But you must first reserve a few of the hairs from the final third and tie them to your sleeves.

Then, you must take a few of those hairs that you have tied to your sleeves and throw them into the fire, so that they burn up. After all, a fire in Jerusalem will soon spread and extend to the entirety of the Israelite people.
This is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say, ‘This drawing on the clay brick represents the city of Jerusalem. I have positioned this city in the middle of all the nations, surrounded by other empires.

However, by doing wicked acts, the citizens of Jerusalem have rejected the norms by which I have commanded and decreed that they should live. They have done this to a greater degree than any of the people who live in nations and empires outside of Israel! After all, in their lifestyles, they have refused the norms by which I have commanded and decreed that they should live.’

For this reason, here is what I, the Lord Yahweh, have to say, ‘You citizens of Jerusalem have been more conceited and disobedient than any of the people of the nations around you. Because of this, you have not lived by the norms that I have commanded and decreed for you. You have not even lived by the norms of the other nations around you!’

For this reason, here is what I, the Lord Yahweh, have to say! ‘Pay attention! Even I, your own God, have become an enemy to you, citizens of Jerusalem. So, I will carry out my norms among you by punishing you in the full view of the nations and empires around you.
Yes, I am about to do something to you that is unlike anything I have ever done before or ever will do again. It will all happen because of your detestable and disgusting actions.

As a result, parents among you will resort to consuming their own children, and children will resort to consuming their own parents. So I will execute the verdict of my just judgments against you. I will forcibly remove anyone who survives from the city and disperse them in every direction.’

This is what the Lord Yahweh declares: ‘I swear by myself: You have defiled the holy place in which I live among you with all your disgusting idols and with the other abominable practices that you do. Because of this, I will withdraw my presence from you. I will neither regard you with pity nor will I save you from my imminent judgments against you.

The actions you took with the hair that you weighed out symbolize what will happen to the people of Jerusalem. Like the third of the hair that you burned, one-third of the citizens of Jerusalem will die inside the city because of the fatal infectious diseases they will experience or because of a lack of food. Like the third that you slashed with your sword, one-third of the people will die outside the city because of the fatal wounds inflicted on them by their enemies’ swords. Finally, like the third that you threw into the wind, I will forcibly disperse the remaining third of the people of Jerusalem in every direction, but I will cause your enemies to pursue them so that they kill them with their swords.

Then I will have fully expressed my anger. I will calm myself from my rage against them, and, since I exacted my just judgments against them, I will console myself. When my wrath against them has subsided, the people who live in Jerusalem will recognize that I, Yahweh, have said everything that I have declared to them because I will never stop loving them as my own people.
So, I will destroy Jerusalem until it is nothing but a ruin. I will turn it into such a place that the people of other nations that are around you will mock it as they walk past.

Yes, my destruction of the city of Jerusalem will make it known as something people mock and tease. But when I execute the verdict of my just judgments against the citizens of Jerusalem, my furious discipline of my people will also serve as a terrifying warning to the other nations that surround you. This will assuredly happen because I, Yahweh, have said it!

Yes, the citizens of Jerusalem will suffer fatal infectious diseases, as if I were shooting deadly arrows against them like a besieging army. I intend these diseases to utterly annihilate the people. When this happens, I will also intensify the severity of the conditions that have resulted in a lethal lack of food. In so doing, I will entirely remove Jerusalem’s supply of bread on which they rely like a walking stick.

Yes, I will cause the citizens of Jerusalem to suffer a lack of food. But I will also release wild and deadly animals against them. They will attack them and murder all of their children. I will make these people suffer fatal infectious diseases and the bloodshed of war, and I will enable their enemies to kill them with their swords. This will all assuredly happen because I, Yahweh, have spoken!’”
Yahweh gave me another message. He said,
“Human, turn toward the mountains of Israel and speak against them what I tell you to say.

You must proclaim, ‘Mountains of Israel, attend to what the Lord Yahweh declares! Here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say to you about the high mountains and hilltops, and to the bottoms of the river streams and the low valleys, “Pay attention to what I am about to do! I will soon dispatch enemy soldiers with swords against you. They will destroy all the elevated ritual places at which you worship other gods.

These warring soldiers will smash and defile all your altars—both those you use for offering meat to the idols of other gods and those you use to offer incense. The soldiers I send against you will kill many Israelite people, and their dead bodies will collapse on the ground in front of the ritual statues they used to worship.

I will ensure that the defiling dead bodies of Israelite people lie in the presence of their ritual statues, and I will strew their ritually impure bones all about the altars on which they used to offer meat sacrifices to their false gods.

Wherever you live, your towns will lie in ruins. The destruction of the coming war will cause you to abandon the elevated places where you used to worship ritual statues, so that they become deserted wastes. The invading armies will obliterate the altars on which you offered meat to other gods. They will crush your ritual statues and hack the altars on which you offered incense to other gods into splinters. In the end, every way that you once devised to honor other gods will become nothing but a useless pile of ruins.

This coming destruction will kill many people, and their dead bodies will drop right in front of you. When all of this occurs, you will finally understand exactly who I am and what I am like—I am Yahweh!

However, I will allow a portion of you to remain alive. You who survive the coming destruction will live in other nations like fugitives attempting to escape your armed enemies. Your enemies will forcibly disperse you and relocate you to live among many other empires.

When this happens, in the very places in which the other nations forcibly deported you, those of you who remain alive will consider me once again and remember who I am. You will finally realize how much deep sorrow and emotional pain you caused me. Your deepest desires were like an adulterating spouse, and you yearned to leave your relationship with me and belong to other gods! These other gods dominated your attention and devotion, like a woman lusting after a man other than her husband! As a result, you will one day feel shameful disgust toward yourselves when you think about all of the evil things you once did with your disgusting and unacceptable behavior.

In the end, you will finally understand exactly who I am and what I am like—I am Yahweh! You will realize that when I said that I would cause these disastrous calamities to happen to you, I would undoubtedly do them!”

So, here is what the Lord Yahweh says, “Ezekiel, clap your hands together and stamp your feet! Exclaim a wail of lament over every disgustingly wicked thing that the Israelite people do! After all, they are all going to die soon—whether by their enemies’ swords, extreme hunger, or rampant infectious diseases.

Those who are far from Jerusalem will fatally suffer rampant infectious diseases, and the swords of Israel’s enemies will murder those who are close to Jerusalem. And those who remain alive after all of that will starve to death in extreme hunger. In this way, I will completely vent my furious anger against them.

The dead bodies of those who die from this disaster will lie intermingled with the ritual statues that they used to worship. They will lie together on every side of the altars on which they used to offer meat sacrifices to other gods, and on every elevated hilltop and on every mountain peak, under every verdant tree and sacred oak—at every place at which the Israelite people once burned pleasing aromatic incense to ritual statues to garner the favor of other gods. When you see this, you will finally understand exactly who I am and what I am like—I am Yahweh!

Yes, I will powerfully confront the Israelite people by causing the entire region of Israel to become a ruined, deserted wasteland—everywhere they have ever lived, from the desert in the most southern parts of Israel as far as the town of Diblah in the remote north. When they see this, they will finally understand exactly who I am and what I am like—I am Yahweh!”’”
Yahweh gave me another message. He said,
“Now, as for you, human, here is what I, the Lord Yahweh, have to say to the inhabitants of the land of Israel, ‘The end is here! Yes, the end is imminent for every single portion of the region.

You people of Israel, your demise is now imminent. I will soon vent my anger against you. I will execute the just sentence that befits your lifestyle and hold you responsible for your disgusting and unacceptable behavior.

I will not have such compassion for you that I relent from my judgments against you. Instead, I will hold you responsible for your lifestyles, and you will experience the just consequences that your disgusting and unacceptable behavior deserves. Then, you will finally understand exactly who I am and what I am like—I am Yahweh!’
Here is something else that I, the Lord Yahweh, have to say, ‘A calamity—an unparalleled calamity! Pay attention! It is imminent.
Your demise is impending. Yes, your final demise is impending! It will soon happen to you, as if you woke it up! Pay attention! It is imminent!

Catastrophe is looming upon you, you who inhabit the territories of Israel. The predetermined moment has arrived! It is nearly Yahweh’s chosen time for judgment! At that time, the sound you hear on the mountains will not be the shouts of joyful celebration —rather, it will be the panicked shouts of anguish!

Very soon, I will fully express my rage against you and vent the anger I feel toward you. I will execute the just sentence that befits your lifestyle and hold you responsible for your disgusting and unacceptable behavior.

I will not have such compassion for you that I relent from my judgments against you. I will hold you responsible for your lifestyles, and you will experience the just consequences that your disgusting and unacceptable behavior deserves. Then, you will finally understand exactly who I am and what I am like. I am Yahweh—the one who is injuring you!

Pay attention! It is nearly Yahweh’s chosen time for judgment! Pay attention! It is about to happen! Catastrophe is looming, as if it is about to burst forth! Just like the branch of a tree that has begun to blossom in the spring, your proud behavior is coming into fruition—it is budding!

Just like a burgeoning tree that produces a new branch, their violent choices have matured into fully formed wicked lifestyles! In the end, none of it will survive the coming destruction— not their large population, nor their excessive wealth, nor their international renown!

Now is the moment! The time that I, Yahweh, have chosen for judgment has arrived! Customers should not rejoice, nor should vendor grieve. After all, I, Yahweh, am furiously angry with the entire Israelite people!

This is because, as long as he remains alive, the vendor will never return to the place where he used to sell his wares. After all, the things that I, Yahweh, have revealed to my prophet pertain to everyone in Israel! It will not fail to happen. No one who commits injustices will be unable to succeed in staying alive.
Israel’s commanders will blow trumpets to ready the army to fight in the war, but no one will respond, because I, Yahweh, am furiously angry with the entire Israelite people!

The armed army of Israel’s enemies will station itself outside Jerusalem, while infectious diseases and a fatal lack of food ravage the city from within. So, Israel’s enemies will murder whoever happens to be outside the city in the fields, and whoever happens to be inside the city will succumb to the fatal infectious diseases as they starve to death in extreme hunger.

Those few who survive the destruction of Jerusalem will flee to the mountains. Their evil behavior will cause each of them to make wailing noises that sound like the cries of pigeons who live in the mountain valleys.
Each survivor will be so afraid that their hands will hang limp at their sides and they will lose control of their bladders.

They will publicly mourn by wearing clothes made from rough cloth, and they will feel such horror, as if it covered them like clothing. The expression on every face will show that they feel ashamed, and everyone will shave his head in his grief.

They will discard their silver coins into the streets and regard their gold coins as if they were made ritually impure with menstrual blood. None of their money will be able to deliver them when I, Yahweh, unleash my raging anger against them. No longer will they use their money to buy food to satisfy their appetites. After all, having a lot of gold and silver has led them to do evil things!

The beautiful treasures that the priest stored in my temple caused the people of Israel to become arrogant and proud. They used the beautiful things that belonged to me, Yahweh, to craft disgusting and abhorrent ritual statues of their false gods. So I, Yahweh, will cause them to regard my sacred treasure as if it had become ritually impure with menstrual blood.

Yes, I will endow the treasures of my temple to strangers as a reward for their military victory against the Israelite people. I will give it to evil, wicked people who live in the nations surrounding Israel as the profit of their war. As a result, these wicked strangers will pollute and ruin it by using it for purposes other than worshiping me.

Then, I, Yahweh, will no longer be present with the Israelite people. I will look away as the warring soldiers of Israel’s enemies pollute and destroy my beloved temple. Yes, bloodthirsty people will enter that sacred place in which I lived among my people, and, as they do so, they will ruin and pollute it.
Forge a set of chains! Israel’s enemies will require them when they capture and indict the murderous Israelite people who occupy the region and the homicidal people who live in Jerusalem!

So I will summon the armies of the most morally repulsive nations to capture the houses of the Israelite people forcibly and live in them themselves. I will humble those arrogant Israelite people who consider themselves strong, as they watch their warring enemies ruin and pollute the sacred places in which they worshiped other gods.
Very soon, when Israel’s enemies terrify them, they will desperately attempt to stop the violence, but will be utterly unable to do so.

The people will suffer ceaseless catastrophes, and rumors about other catastrophes will proliferate endlessly. The Israelite people will beg Yahweh’s prophets to inform them of Yahweh’s desires and decisions, but the priests will no longer teach people what Yahweh told his people in his instructions to Moses, nor will the elderly give wise advice anymore.

Israel’s king will grieve, and his son will feel such despair, as if he wore it like clothing; everywhere in Israel, people will feel incapacitated by their horror. I will do to the Israelite people what their lifestyles deserve; I will legally evaluate and condemn them by their own legal standards. Then, they will finally understand exactly who I am and what I am like—I am Yahweh!’”

Some time later, on the fifth day of the sixth month of the year—six years after the Babylonian army forcibly removed me from the land of Judah, along with King Jehoiachin and many others—I was sitting inside my house, and the elders of Judah were sitting in front of me. Right there, at that moment, the Lord Yahweh powerfully enabled me to see and proclaim his messages.

As I watched, I suddenly saw a humanoid figure resembling a blazing fire. I noticed that what seemed like his waist and below looked as if it were on fire. Above what seemed like his waist, the bodily form of this humanoid figure resembled the radiating glow of molten, white-hot metal.

Then, the blazing figure reached out what looked like a hand and grabbed me by a strand of hair at the top of my head. Then the wind of Yahweh’s Spirit lifted me up into the sky, so that I hovered between the earth and the sky. Then, in this vision from God, the wind carried me along to Jerusalem. I arrived at the gated entrance to the inner court of the temple—that is, the entrance that faces north. There, I saw a sculpted ritual statue of a god other than Yahweh. This seated idol incited impassioned jealousy within Yahweh.

Then, suddenly, in front of me, I saw the glorious brilliance that showed me that the God of Israel was there with me. It looked just like what I had seen several months before, when I was in the valley along the Kebar River.

Then Yahweh said to me, “Human, look up now and gaze northwards.” So I looked up and gazed northwards. Then I could see that sculpted ritual image that incited impassioned jealousy within Yahweh, sitting in an area to the north of the gated entrance to the inner courtyard, through which one could see the altar on which priests entirely burned up meat sacrifices to Yahweh.

Then Yahweh said to me, “Human, just look at what they are doing! The entire Israelite people are doing extraordinarily disgusting and inappropriate things here! They are alienating me from my own sacred temple! Still, you will soon witness things that are even more extraordinarily disgusting and inappropriate.”
Then Yahweh brought me to the entrance of the temple courtyard. When I looked, I noticed a hole in the north wall of the temple.
Yahweh said to me, “Human, dig into the wall here.” So I started to dig into the wall, and suddenly an entrance appeared.
Then Yahweh said to me, “Go in through the entrance and witness the morally repulsive, disgusting things that people are doing inside my temple.”

So I went in and looked around. There, I saw that on every part of each wall of the room, someone had engraved depictions of every sort of ritually impure crawling animal imaginable, along with all kinds of disgusting animals, and depictions of every other god that the people of Israel worshiped by honoring ritual statues.

In front of all these engravings stood 70 of the elders of the Israelite people. Even Jaazaniah, the son of Shaphan, one of the military commanders of King Zedekiah, was standing among them! Each person was holding his own metal pan for ritually wafting the smoke of burning incense. As they stood, a thick aromatic cloud of incense smoke was rising up.

Then Yahweh said to me, “Human, just look at what the elders of the Israelite people are doing in the dark—each one of them standing in an interior room full of engravings of his gods! They reason with themselves: ‘Surely, Yahweh cannot see us; he has left his home in the temple and vacated the land of Israel.’”
He continued, “Soon, you will witness again these people doing things that are even more extraordinarily disgusting and inappropriate.”

Then he brought me to the opening of the northern gated entrance of Yahweh’s temple. I suddenly noticed a group of women sitting there. They were weeping, performing a ritual lament that grieved for Tammuz, the deceased Mesopotamian god-king!
Then Yahweh said to me, “Human, just look at this! Yet still, you will again witness things that are even more extraordinarily disgusting and inappropriate than this.”

He brought me into the interior courtyard of Yahweh’s temple. Suddenly, I noticed that there, at the very entrance of Yahweh’s temple, between the entrance’s porch and the altar in the middle of the interior courtyard, stood about 25 men. They had turned their backs to Yahweh’s temple and were instead facing east. I noticed that they were bowing low in an act of reverential worship to the sun, the manifestation of the god Shamash.

Then Yahweh said to me, “Human, just look at this! Yet, these disgusting and inappropriate practices that the people of Judah are doing here, in my temple, are the least serious offense they have committed. Everywhere they live, these people behave violently, never ceasing to anger and grieve me. Yes, look! Their arrogant, violent crimes against one another openly insult and disrespect me, as if they were mockingly waving a stick in my face!

Therefore, I myself will behave angrily. I will not feel such tender sympathy for these people that I restrain my anger against them. Even when they desperately invoke me and shout my name, I will simply ignore them.”
Then I heard Yahweh shout, “You who perform public executions within the city of Jerusalem, approach! Arm yourselves with your lethal weapons.”

Suddenly, I noticed that six men were arriving from the direction of the upper gated entrance to the temple courtyard—that is, the one that faces north. Each one of them had armed himself with a deadly and destructive weapon. Among them stood one man who wore linen clothing, and he had strapped a writing kit to his waist, such as a scribe carries. They entered the temple courtyard and positioned themselves beside the bronze altar.

Then the glorious brilliance that showed that the God of Israel was with me ascended above the winged beings over which it had previously rested, and it moved to the very doorstep of Yahweh’s temple. Then Yahweh addressed the man who wore the linen clothing, who also had strapped the scribal writing kit to his waist.

Yahweh said to him, “Proceed throughout the city of Jerusalem. As you do, mark the foreheads of every person who laments and grieves all the disgusting and inappropriate things that the people are doing inside the city with the letter ‘X.’”

While I was listening, Yahweh said to the five other men, “Follow that man through the city and kill everyone he does not mark. Do not allow yourself to feel such compassion toward them that you restrain yourself from harming them.

Anyone you come across—old people, young people, or children—kill them all! But remember! You must not harm anyone whose forehead has the letter ‘X’ on it. Now, begin at my temple.” So they began with the elders who were prostrating themselves in worship of the sun in front of Yahweh’s temple.

Then Yahweh said to the five men, “Ritually desecrate my temple by filling its two courtyards with the dead bodies of the people you kill! Now, move out!” So they went out and started killing people in the city.

And so, as the six men went out killing, I remained there alone. I threw myself face down on the ground and exclaimed, “Oh, Lord Yahweh! Are you going to completely eradicate the Israelite people as you vent your anger against the people of Jerusalem? Those living in this city are all that remain of the Israelite people!”

He answered me, “The people of Israel and Judah have committed innumerable heinous injustices. Everywhere they live, these people behave violently, and this very city is brimming with corrupt and perverse people! After all, they speculate by saying, ‘Yahweh has left his home in the temple and vacated the land of Israel.’ They also reason with themselves, ‘Surely, Yahweh cannot see us.’
Therefore, I myself also will not have such compassion for them that I restrain myself from justly punishing them. Instead, I will hold them accountable for their lifestyles.”
At that moment, the man who wore the linen clothing, who also had strapped the scribal kit to his waist, returned. He reported, “I have done exactly as you commanded.”

Then, as I continued to look on, I suddenly noticed that a shape appeared above the vaulted, crystalline dome that arched high over the heads of the four cherubim. It looked like a throne made of a very valuable blue stone.

Yahweh then spoke to the man who wore the linen clothing. He said, “Go to the spaces in between the whirling array of wheels that are under the cherubim. Take two handfuls of the live coals from the cherubim, and scatter them over the city of Jerusalem.” Then, as I watched, the man went.
Now, when the man went in to collect the live coals, the four winged cherubim were standing at attention on the south side of the temple, and a thick cloud suffused the temple’s inner courtyard.

Then, Yahweh’s glorious presence ascended over the four cherubim and repositioned itself to the doorway of Yahweh’s temple. The thick cloud suffused the temple, and the brilliant light that came from Yahweh’s glorious presence saturated the temple’s interior courtyard.

The noise that the cherubim’s wings generated when they advanced was so loud that people in the outer courtyard of the temple could hear it! It sounded like the speaking voice of the all-powerful God.

So, when Yahweh commanded the man who wore the linen clothing to procure live coals from among the whirling array of wheels, from among the winged cherubim, the man went and stood at attention beside one of the four wheels.

Then the winged cherubim beside whose wheel the man stood reached out his hand, moving it toward the fire that burned among the four cherubim. He picked up some of the live coals and put them into the two open hands of the man who wore the linen clothing. The man took them and left.
Now, it appeared that each cherubim possessed what resembled human hands underneath its four wings.

So I continued to watch. Once again, I noticed the four wheels that moved beside the winged cherubim. Each cherubim possessed a single wheel beside it. The wheels themselves appeared to glisten like the gleam of a fine topaz.
As for their appearance, all four wheels were identical: Each one resembled a gyroscope, made of a single wheel intersecting another wheel at a right angle.

Whenever they advanced, the wheels never moved in a circuitous manner. Instead, they always advanced straight forward in one of the four directions, corresponding to the direction that each of the faces of the four-faced cherubim looked.
The entirety of each cherubim—their bodies, their backs, their hands, their wings, and all four wheels—was completely covered with eyes.
I heard someone identify the cherubim’s wheels as “the whirling array of wheels.”
Now, each winged creature possessed four faces—first, a cherub’s face; then a human face; third, a lion’s face; and fourth, an eagle’s face.
Then the four cherubim ascended. (These were the same creatures that I had previously seen beside the Kebar River.)

When the winged cherubim advanced, their wheels advanced beside them. Similarly, when the winged cherubim extended their four wings in order to ascend from the ground—never turning about as they went—so also did their wheels remain beside them.

Whenever the cherubim stopped moving, their wheels also stopped. And whenever the creatures ascended, so too did their wheels ascend alongside them. This was because the wheels contained the creatures’ spirit that gave them life.
Then, the brilliant light of Yahweh’s glorious presence advanced away from the doorway of Yahweh’s temple and halted above the winged cherubim.

Before my very eyes, the winged cherubim extended their four wings and ascended from the ground—their wheels ascending beside them as they advanced. Then the procession of Yahweh and the four cherubim paused at the doorway of the eastern gated entrance to Yahweh’s temple, and the brilliant and glorious presence of the very God of Israel hovered above the winged cherubim.
(Now, these were the same creatures that I had seen advancing underneath the God of Israel beside the Kebar River. I recognized them as the angelic beings that people call cherubim.
Yes, four—each of the cherubim possessed four faces and four wings, and underneath each of their wings, they possessed what resembled human hands.

As for the appearance of their faces—they looked as they did when I saw them alongside the Kebar River. Each of them advanced forward in the direction of one of their four faces—either north, south, east, or west.)

Then the wind of Yahweh’s spirit lifted me up and carried me to the eastern gated entrance of Yahweh’s temple. There, standing at the gate, I suddenly noticed 25 men. Among them, I recognized two public officials: Jaazaniah, the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah, the son of Benaiah.
Yahweh said to me, “Human, these are the men who have made thinking about doing corrupt things a habit and consistently give the citizens of Jerusalem immoral and disastrous advice.

These men tell the people in their jurisdiction, ‘It is not the right moment to think about building houses. This city keeps us, its most honorable and divinely-favored officials, safe, just as a cooking pot conserves the choice meat that is inside it.’
So, declare my prophetic pronouncements against them! Yes, prophesy human!”

Then Yahweh’s Spirit empowered me, and Yahweh told me to declare these words: “Here is what Yahweh has to say, ‘Israelite people, you have been talking like this in public, but I, Yahweh, know exactly what you are thinking!
You have killed innumerable people in this city. Dead bodies lie everywhere on every street in Jerusalem!’

Consequently, here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say, ‘The corpses that you have strewn throughout this city are like the meat, and this city is like the cooking pot. But as for you—I will forcibly remove you from Jerusalem.
You are afraid of dying in the violent conflict of war. So I will dispatch the violent conflict of war against you.’ That is what the Lord Yahweh declares!
‘I, Yahweh, will forcibly remove you from this city, Jerusalem, and consign you to the authority of foreign empires. So I will execute my legal judgments against you.

Your armed enemies will kill you with their weapons. I will enforce my legal rulings against you within the tribal territories of the Israelite people. At that time, you will finally understand exactly who I am and what I am like—I am Yahweh!

This city, Jerusalem, will not preserve you the way a cooking pot conserves meat within it. To the contrary, I will execute my just verdicts against you within the tribal territories of the Israelite people.

At that time, you will finally understand exactly who I am and what I am like—I am Yahweh! It is my instructions and my norms that you have ignored and refused to live by. Instead, you have chosen to live by the norms of the other nations around you!’”

Then, as I was prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah suddenly died. I threw myself down with my face to the ground and exclaimed with a shout, “O Lord Yahweh! You are going to completely eradicate the only Israelite people who remain alive!”
Then Yahweh gave me another message. He said,

“Human, the people who yet live in the city of Jerusalem are making claims about you and your relatives—your closest family—and about all the rest of the Israelite people whom the Babylonians forcibly removed from Israel. Those left in Jerusalem claim, ‘Let those exiles remain far away from Yahweh. After all, Yahweh has conferred this land to us as our property.’

Consequently, inform them, ‘Here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say, “Yes, I resettled the exiles among the nations far away and strewed them among the neighboring empires. Nonetheless, wherever they now live, I have been with them. I will lovingly protect them, as if I were a sacred refuge for them.”’

Also inform them: ‘Here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say, “When I bring all of you back from your exile among the non-Israelite peoples, and I regather you from the empires among which I scattered you, I will give you back the Israelite territory.

Then those whom the Babylonians forcibly removed from Israel will return to their homelands. They will deface and destroy every detestable ritual statue and every disgusting and indecent idol, entirely removing them from the Israelite territory.

At that time, I will unify the entire Israelite people so that they feel, think, and live together in harmony. It will be as if they all have one mind! I will also revive and empower the Israelite people with a new desire to live as I want them to. It will be as if I have given them a new life! I will change the arrogant, stubborn, and ineffective ways they used to feel, think, and live. In their place, I will enable the Israelite people to deeply desire to feel, think, and live as I want them to. It will be as if I removed a dead, rocky heart from them and put a living, responsive heart in its place.

This unified mind and renewed life that I will give to the Israelite people will enable them to carefully live their lives by practicing the norms and instructions that I disclosed to them. When this happens, you, Israelite people, will finally and truly live as my special people, and I myself will belong to you as the only God that you worship, love, and trust.

Yet, those Israelite people who devote themselves to worshiping other gods by honoring their detestable ritual images and their disgusting and indecent idols—I will hold them accountable for their life choices.” That is what the Lord Yahweh declares.”
Then the winged cherubim raised their four wings, with their wheels beside them, while the brilliant light of the glorious presence of Israel’s God hovered above them.
Then, Yahweh’s glorious presence rose from where it had been hovering in the middle of Jerusalem. It halted above the mountain on the eastern side of the city.

At that moment, as the Spirit of God showed me what he wanted me to see, the wind of Yahweh’s Spirit raised me up and brought me back to the domains of the Babylonian empire, where the Israelite exiles were currently living. Then I stopped seeing the prophetic visions Yahweh had been giving me.
Then I began to tell the Israelite exiles everything that Yahweh had shown me.
Then Yahweh spoke another message to me. He said,

“Human, you live amidst the Israelite people, who reject my authority and openly defy me! They may have eyes that can see, but the people refuse to perceive their actions the way I do. They may have ears that can hear, but the people refuse to heed my messages to them. After all, these people reject my authority and openly defy me!

As for you, human—you must prepare a bag in which you would pack your belongings should an enemy army capture you and forcibly remove you from your homeland. During the daytime, you should act as though enemy armies were forcibly removing you from your home, and, as these people watch, you should travel to another place. Even though these people reject my authority and openly defy me, perhaps your symbolic actions will help them to finally see their actions the way that I do.

When it is daytime, you should bring the bag you prepared out of your house while they watch, like an exile would if an enemy army forcibly removed him from his home. But then, as the people continue to watch, you should leave your home in the evening, just as an exile would.
Next, as they watch, you must begin to dig a hole through the wall of your house and carry the bag you prepared out through the hole.

While they continue to watch, you should hoist your bag onto your shoulder. Then, when it becomes twilight, carry it out through the hole you dug. As you come out of the hole in your wall, you must cover your face so that you are unable to see the land. I want you to perform these symbolic actions because I have made you into an object lesson that will teach the Israelite people.”

So I did exactly what Yahweh commanded me to do. In the daytime, I brought the bag that I prepared out of my house, just as an exile might do. Then, in the evening, I used my hands to dig myself a hole in the wall of my house. When it became twilight, I hoisted my bag onto my shoulder and, as the Israelite exiles watched, I carried it back out of my house through the hole in the wall.
The next morning, Yahweh spoke this message to me,
“Human, as you performed those symbolic actions, the Israelite people—those who reject my authority and openly defy me—have inquired about what you are doing.

So, tell them, ‘Here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say, “This heavy bag that I carry on my shoulder represents Zedekiah, the current illegitimate ruler of Jerusalem, and all the Israelite people who live in Jerusalem. They are a weighty burden.”’

Tell them, ‘Let my symbolic actions teach you something that Yahweh wants you to understand. Notice what I have done. The same thing will happen to the citizens of Jerusalem: Their enemies will march them out of Jerusalem as exiles and prisoners.’

Yes, Zedekiah, the illegitimate ruler of the citizens of Jerusalem, will hoist a bag onto his shoulder when it becomes twilight, and he will leave the city. This will happen as the armies of Israel’s enemies dig a hole through the walls of Jerusalem, which they will create to carry Zedekiah out through it. As he departs, the false king will cover his face so that he does not see the place that he is leaving.

However, I will trap and capture Zedekiah, as if I caught him in a hunting trap. Then, I will bring him to the city of Babylon, where the Babylonian people live (but he will never see that place, because the Babylonians will blind him). In that place, Zedekiah will die.
I will disperse his entire retinue in every direction—his advisors and all his military troops. I will dispatch enemy soldiers with swords to hunt them.
Then, when I forcibly relocated them among the many nations and empires, they will all finally understand exactly who I am and what I am like—I am Yahweh!

Yet, I will allow a few of them to survive the violence of war, the fatal lack of food, and the wasting infectious diseases. As a result, when they settle among the nations where their enemies relocate them, they will report all the disgusting and indecent things that they once did. When this happens, the people who hear these reports will finally understand exactly who I am and what I am like—I am Yahweh!”
Yahweh spoke another message to me. He said,
“Human, you should tremble with fear while you eat your food, and shudder anxiously while you drink your water.

Tell the people of the regions of Israel, ‘Here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say to those who still live in Jerusalem about the land in Israel, “They will be anxious while they eat their food, and they will tremble in devastated horror while they drink their water. After all, Israel’s enemies will devastate the land by destroying every kind of crop that grows in Israel. This will happen because everyone who lives in the Israelite regions continues to harm one another violently.

Israel’s enemies will raze Israel’s cities in which people live until they are nothing but ruins, and the land itself will become an empty, devastated wasteland. Then, those who remain alive in the Israelite regions will finally understand exactly who I am and what I am like—I am Yahweh!”’”
Yahweh spoke another message to me. He said,
“Human, the people who remain alive in Israel keep repeating this saying about the Israelite regions: ‘The days go by, but nothing that the prophets declared in their divine visions ever happens.’

So tell them, ‘Here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say, “I am making this colloquial saying irrelevant and no longer true. The Israelite people will never again speak it.”’ However, also inform them, ‘Soon, everything that the prophets have declared in their divine visions will happen!
From now on, no prophet among the Israelite people will declare deceitful visions that they fabricated, nor will they read divine messages from nature only to flatter people with positive messages.

Surely I, Yahweh, still speak! And I will accomplish what I have spoken! It will happen exactly when I declare that it will. Yes, while you—you Israelite people who reject my authority and revolt against me—are still alive, I will accomplish what I have spoken. That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.’”
Then Yahweh spoke another message to me. He said,

“Human, pay attention! Notice how the Israelite people keep remarking, ‘The prophetic messages that this man, Ezekiel, sees in his divine visions concern events far into the future. Surely, he is proclaiming prophetic messages that only pertain to generations who live after us!’

So, tell them, ‘Here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say about that, “The things that I have spoken about will happen now, exactly when I declared that they will! Yes, I am about to accomplish what I have spoken.” This is what the Lord Yahweh declares!’”
Yahweh gave me another message. He said,

“Human, speak my prophetic messages against those Israelite prophets who speak authoritatively to the people. Some of them tell people things that they have contrived as if I said them! Tell them: ‘Listen to what Yahweh really says!

Here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say to you: How terrible it will be for those senseless prophets who authoritatively speak like my prophet but only heed their own ideas without having received any messages from me!
Israelite people, the prophets who advise you and speak to you have become useless and predatory—like ravenous jackals that scavenge among the ruins of a city.

Like masons who fail to repair the cracks in deteriorating defensive walls, you prophets have done nothing to protect your people! You have not prepared the Israelite people to survive the coming destruction that will occur when I, Yahweh, besiege and destroy Jerusalem!

The messages that these prophets purport to have received from me are deceitful and fraudulent! Every divine insight they provide is nothing but a lie! Sure, they claim, “This is what Yahweh has declared.” Yet, I did not send them to you! Nevertheless, they fully expect that their contrived prophetic declarations will happen!

Isn’t this true? You prophets purport to have received prophetic messages from me, but they are deceitful and fraudulent! You prophets claim to provide divine insight, but it is all lies! You prophets claim, “This is what Yahweh has declared,” but I never spoke to you!

So, here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say: You prophets have only spoken deceitfully and fraudulently! You have lied when you reported messages that you said came from me! Consequently, pay attention! I am now your enemy. That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.

I will work against you prophets who deceitfully and fraudulently claim to receive messages from me and who falsely claim to provide divine insight. You will no longer be a part of the community of my people, Israel. No one will record your names in the civil register of the Israelite people, nor will you ever return to the territories of Israel. When all this happens, you false prophets will finally understand exactly who I am and what I am like—I am the Lord Yahweh!

I am the enemy of these false prophets principally because they intentionally deceive my people, Israel, by proclaiming, “Everything is well!” when nothing is well! It is as though the Israelite officials have built a rickety wall without the proper mortar. Then, rather than expose the faults in the walls that the officials have poorly constructed, these false prophets daub the rickety wall with white plaster to make it look stable.

Tell those prophets—the ones who, by falsely declaring that all is well, daub the Israelite official’s rickety wall with white plaster—that their wall will soon collapse! It will fall apart under the strain of the flooding rainstorms, the falling hailstones, and the violent windstorms that I, Yahweh, am about to unleash!
When your wall collapses, people will surely ask you, false prophets, “What happened to the white plaster that you daubed on it?”

So here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say to you, false prophets: I am angrily unleashing violent windstorms, furiously unloading flooding rainstorms, and irately sending falling hailstones to obliterate that rickety wall.

I will raze the wall that you daubed with plaster. I will level it to the ground so that everyone can see its foundation. It will collapse, and you will die alongside it. When all this happens, you false prophets will finally understand exactly who I am and what I am like—I am Yahweh!

That is how I will vent my anger against the Israelite officials’ wall and against those false prophets who daubed it with white plaster. At that time, I will say to you, “Your wall is gone, and so are those who daubed it with plaster—

those false Israelite prophets who proclaim authoritative prophetic messages about the citizens of Jerusalem and claim to receive divine declarations from me that all would be well for the city, when nothing will be well!” That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.’

Now you human, turn toward the Israelite women who feign to speak authoritatively to the people. Some of these women tell people things that they have contrived as if I said them! Declare my prophetic messages against them.

Tell them, ‘Here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say: How terrible it will be for you women who manufacture magic bands to fasten on people’s wrists, who craft magic talismans that you encourage people of all sizes to wear over their heads! You do these things not to help people but to ensnare and harm them! Yes, you attempt to ensnare my people, Israel, and harm them. But I will ensnare and harm you!

You have debased me in my people’s perceptions—and all in exchange for a few handfuls of barley and a few scraps of bread! By lying to my people, who heed your lies, you have murdered people who should not have died, and you have rescued people who should not have lived.

So, here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say: Witness me! I am now an enemy to your magic bands, which you use to ensnare people as though they were birds. I will rip those magic bands off your forearms, and I will release the people whom you attempt to ensnare and harm like birds.

I will also rip off your magic talismans and thereby deliver my people, Israel, from your control. No longer will you dominate and harm them, as though they were birds that you hunted for sport. Then, you false prophetesses will finally understand exactly who I am and what I am like—I am Yahweh!

You have demoralized honest and integrous people by lying to them—even though I myself did nothing to cause them emotional pain! You have also encouraged dishonest and immoral people! As a result, these people did not stop their corrupt behavior—or else they would have stayed alive. Because of these actions,

you will no longer claim to receive deceitful and fraudulent messages from me or provide divine insight to people! Instead, I will deliver my people, Israel, from your control. Then, when all this happens, you false prophetesses will finally understand exactly who I am and what I am like—I am Yahweh!’”
One day, some of the elders of the Israelite people came to me and sat down in front of me.
Then Yahweh gave me this message,

“Human, these elderly men have devotedly committed themselves to their ritual statues. They have fixed their attention on those idols, which has caused them to behave immorally! Why are these men asking me what to do? They certainly have no right to ask me for advice!

So, tell them, ‘Here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say, “Any Israelite could devotedly commit himself to his ritual statues and fix his attention on those idols that cause him to behave immorally. But whenever such a person then comes to one of Yahweh’s prophets to request advice from me, I, Yahweh, will answer him myself—in such a way that his extensive worship of innumerable idols deserves!

I will answer them in this way so that I may capture the devoted attention and affection of the Israelite people—all of whom have alienated themselves from me by worshiping other gods through their ritual statues.”’
Consequently, tell the Israelite people, ‘Here is what the Lord Yahweh has to say: “Repent! Stop worshiping your idols, and stop all your other disgusting and indecent practices!

Any Israelite, or any foreigner living among the Israelite people, could ritually dedicate himself to another god and disavow me and then begin to commit himself devotedly to his ritual statues and fix his attention on those idols that cause him to behave immorally. But whenever such a person then comes to one of Yahweh’s prophets and asks him for my insight, I, Yahweh, will answer him personally.

I will become that man’s enemy and oppose him. I will make what happens to him a warning to others and something that people talk about in their proverbs. I will make that person an outcast from the Israelite people. Then, when all this happens, my people, Israel, will finally understand exactly who I am and what I am like—I am Yahweh!

But a prophet may foolishly allow the deceitful idol-worshiper to lure him to speak authoritatively on my behalf. If this happens, then I, Yahweh, have lured that prophet into behaving foolishly. I will use my power to obliterate him and ostracize him from my people, the Israelites.
I will hold accountable both the prophet and the person who asks him for my insight. Yes, I will consider them equally guilty.

I will do this so that the Israelite people will remain devoted to me, no longer straying away from me. They will no longer rebel against me in such a way that makes them ritually unfit to worship me. They will be my people, and I will be their God.” That is what the Lord Yahweh declares.’”
Then Yahweh gave me another message. He said,

“Human, suppose a group of people disloyally betray their promises to me and so act sinfully. Suppose I used my power against them, and I crippled their food supply on which they rely, and so caused the conditions for a fatal lack of food among them. Suppose I caused the deaths of many people and animals there.

If that were to happen, even if the most virtuous people imaginable lived among those people—men like Noah, Daniel, and Job—those men’s virtuous actions could not abate my destruction against the people. Their virtuous actions would only save themselves. That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.

Or suppose I sent rampaging animals throughout the homeland of those people. Suppose the wild animals attacked and killed so many people that those who survived deserted the region, and no one traveled through it because of those animals.

I, Yahweh, swear by myself that even if those three men lived in that region—even though they are the most virtuous people you can imagine—they would not be able to prevent the deaths of even their own sons or daughters. Only those three men would remain alive, while the entire region would become ruinous and desolate. That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.

Or suppose I dispatched the armed forces of an enemy empire against that region. Suppose I proclaimed, ‘May enemy soldiers bring their swords and wage war throughout the region!’ and then that they murdered both people and animals there.

I, Yahweh, swear by myself that even if those three men lived in that region, they would not be able to prevent the deaths of even their own sons or daughters. Yes, those three men alone would remain alive. That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.
Or suppose I discharged a fatal infectious disease throughout that region and vented my anger against those people, so as to cause the deaths of many people and animals there.

I, Yahweh, swear by myself that even if the most virtuous people imaginable lived in that region—men like Noah, Daniel, and Job—they would not be able to prevent the deaths of even their own sons or daughters. Their virtuous actions would only save themselves. That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.

So this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say, ‘It will be far worse for the citizens of Jerusalem! I will cause the deaths of both people and animals in Jerusalem when I unleash all four of my calamitous punishments: Armed soldiers will murder some with their swords, a fatal lack of food in the city will kill some, raging wild animals will kill others, and lethal infectious diseases will kill still others.

But pay attention! Some of the citizens of Jerusalem will survive these disasters. Watch for them! I will take the survivors out of the city, both sons and daughters, and they will travel to you in exile in the Babylonian Empire. When you observe their lifestyles and how they have conducted themselves, you will feel relief about all the calamities that I unleashed against the city of Jerusalem.

When you observe the lifestyles of those survivors and how they have conducted themselves, you will feel relieved. You will understand that everything that I did to Jerusalem was well-motivated.’ That is what I, the Lord Yahweh, declare.”
Yahweh gave me another message. He said,
“Human, what do people do with the woody stock of grapevines—that is, with the vine branches that people find growing among forested trees?
No one uses the woody stock from a grapevine to make anything useful. No one even makes a peg with it on which to hang things!
Pay attention! They simply burn it as fuel for fires. The fire burns both ends and eventually destroys even its middle. It is good for nothing else!

Think about it! Even when the grapevine branch was still in one piece, no one made anything useful with it. So, now that the fire has burned it up, certainly no one will use it to make anything useful!

So this is what I, the Lord Yahweh, say, ‘The citizens of Jerusalem will suffer the same fate as the woody stock of the grapevine—the ones that people find growing among the forested trees, which they use as fuel for fires.

I have become their enemy. Even though the people who currently live in Jerusalem have escaped destruction before, the coming disasters will annihilate them. When I act as their enemy, you who live in exile in the Babylonian Empire will finally understand exactly who I am and what I am like—I am Yahweh!
I will transform the land into a desolate and ruinous wasteland—all because these people disloyally betrayed their promises to me.’ That is what the Lord Yahweh declares.”
Yahweh gave me another message. He said,
“Human, inform the citizens of Jerusalem of the disgusting and illicit things that they have done.

Tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh has to say to you citizens of Jerusalem, “Imagine that this city and those who live in it were a woman. Her ancestry was Canaanite, from the regions where the Canaanites lived. Your father was ethnically Amorite, and your mother was ethnically Hittite.

Imagine your birth story: On the day your mother gave birth to you, no one cut your umbilical cord; no one bathed you to ritually cleanse you, and no one rubbed you with salt or swaddled you in cloths.

No one who saw you felt enough empathy for you to do any of those things for you or to spare you from your condition. Instead, on the day she gave birth to you, your mother despised you so much that she threw you out into an open field.
Then I came across you and witnessed you floundering in your own spilt blood. As you lay there, helpless in your blood, I said to you, ‘Live! Yes, live!’

I caused you to flourish like a sprouting plant growing in a field. You grew tall and came to a marriageable age, wearing the finest jewelry. Your body matured, and your hair grew long. However, you were still completely naked.

Later, when I came across you, I looked at you again. I noticed that you were now old enough to marry. So I covered your naked body with the edge of my clothing to demonstrate that I would marry you and protect you. I made a solemn promise to you and entered into a marriage covenant with you, and you became my wife.” That is what the Lord Yahweh declares.
“Then I bathed you, washed the blood off you, and rubbed olive oil onto your skin.
Then I dressed you in colorful embroidered clothing and strapped leather sandals to your feet. I outfitted you in fine linen and clad you in silken cloth.
I adorned you with fine jewelry: I fastened bracelets on your wrists and a chain necklace around your neck.
I gave you a nose ring and earrings and placed a beautiful crown on your head.

So you wore gold and silver jewelry, and you dressed in the finest linen clothing, silken cloth, and colorful embroidery. Your food comprised the finest flour, honey, and olive oil. So, you became exceedingly beautiful, and you became a queen.

You gained a reputation for being so exceedingly beautiful that people in other nations heard about you. After all, the magnificent radiance that I, your husband, had given you made you perfectly beautiful.” That is what the Lord Yahweh declares.

“Yet, your beauty made you self-assured. You used your international renown to act like a prostitute. You freely offered illicit sexual favors to every man you came across, and they enjoyed your beautiful body.
You used some of your beautiful clothing to make yourself gaudy, decorated shrines. On them, you behaved like a prostitute. Yes, you had illicit sex with men, and they enjoyed your beautiful body.
You also used the beautiful gold and silver jewelry that I had given you to fashion ritual statues with male anatomy, and you had illicit sexual relations with them.
You took your embroidered clothes and clothed your ritual statues with them, and you placed my oil and my incense as votive offerings in their presence.

You also took the food that I gave you— the fine flour, olive oil, and honey that I fed you—and you presented it in the presence of those ritual statues as pleasingly aromatic votive offerings. That is exactly what happened.” That is what the Lord Yahweh declares.
“You even took your sons and your daughters, the children that you had borne to me, and you sacrificed them as food to those idols. Was your prostitution such a small matter to you,
that you also butchered my children and burned them alive as offerings to those ritual statues?

All the while, when you were committing these disgusting, heinous actions and prostituting yourself, you never once remembered your birth story, when you were completely naked, floundering in your own blood!
How terrible it will be for you!” That is what the Lord Yahweh declares! “So, after you did all those heinous acts,
you constructed a domed building for yourself and erected lofty shrines in every public square.

At every street intersection, you constructed your lofty shrine. So you made your once-beautiful body abominable, offering yourself to every man you came across. So, more and more, you behaved like a prostitute.
Then you even had illicit sex with the Egyptians, your well-endowed neighbors, and so you acted more and more like a prostitute, never ceasing to anger and grieve me.
So I acted powerfully against you and reduced your apportioned rations. So I let the Philistine people do what they wanted with you. They despised you, and yet your obscene behavior embarrassed them!
You also had illicit sexual relations with the Assyrian people because you were insatiable. You behaved like a prostitute with them, and yet even then you could not satisfy your desires!
So, you behaved more and more like a prostitute, reaching all the way to the territories of the Babylonian Empire! Yet even that did not satisfy your desires!
How weak-willed you are! You love the wrong things!” That is what the Lord Yahweh declares. “You did all these things, acting like an impudent prostitute who does whatever she wants.

When you constructed your domed brothel at every street intersection and erected your lofty shrines in every public square, you were not even like an ordinary prostitute, because you refused to accept payment.
You are an unfaithful wife, who prefers strangers to her own husband!
Prostitutes usually receive gifts from men, but you gave your gifts to all your lovers; you bribed them to come to you from all around to have illicit sexual relations with you!

So as you behaved like a prostitute, you were the opposite of other women. No man solicited you; instead, you paid them, and they did not pay you. In this way, you were the exact opposite of a normal prostitute!”
So then, you prostitute, heed Yahweh’s message!
